title: How to retire early using compound interest and AI investing

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "how" is clear—compound interest and AI investing can retire you in 10 years with smart protocols and automated compounding.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The "to" is critical—without the right tools, even the best strategies fail. AI investing needs precise targeting, not just automation.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My strategy uses real-time AI rebalancing and tax-loss harvesting via protocols like Alpaca and QuantConnect to maximize returns.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even the best tools can't outperform a well-defined "to"—without a clear path, you’re just chasing noise in the market.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You can't compound on nothing. The "to" defines purpose, strategy, and risk—without it, the "how" is just random noise.
